notes: Inspired by @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Utility PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for movement tech in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. Sullen Claw is a Lightweight frame sword, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic for having mediocre damage, but high reserves. The stats are decent by comparison with other lightweight swords - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/1085743380 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. The heavy dash attacks with lightweights cost 3 ammo. To be honest, you can probably use any blade and guard perk for an Eager Edge sword - using a Backup Mag mod means there's not a huge difference in ammo reserves, and you'll not really be blocking that much in normal use. To pair with Eager Edge which provides a ×1.8 increased grounded lunge and ×1.6 airborne lunge (×2 and ×1.8 when enhanced) for 3s after readying, you might as well look for something that helps with damage. In the second column, there's Destabilizing Rounds, Whirlwind Blade or Sword Logic, or Assassin's Blade for a bit of extra movement speed and damage after a kill. The Origin Trait, Imperial Allegiance grants a stack for each ally in 15m, up to ×3, to boost both the charge rate and damage when guard energy is low by up to a max of ×1.105, so is ideal for working in a fireteam. If you're interested, this is modelled on the vibroswords commonly utilized by CIS BX-series droid commandos. Recommended MW: Impact with a Backup Mag mod or your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.

If you're interested, this is modelled on the vibroswords commonly utilized by CIS BX-series droid commandos. SpaceMonkey (PvE / God-PvE): "Very cool sword, especially this season with all the support for swords in the artifact. The double damage perks here are great, and make this a good "no setup required" heavy sword DPS option. Eager Edge is probably the actual draw here though as the sword gets way more ammo at base than other frames and the light attack is both a faster animaton and more aggressive forward momentum." Recommended MW: Impact.
